name: irroots
tagline: Find every IRR of a cash flow, or prove there is none, using exact root isolation instead of Newton
trendOrigin: Sunk Cost (how long a local LLM rig takes to pay for itself). Payback and IRR calculators assume a cash flow has one rate of return. Flows with a big upfront cost, running costs and a resale or decommissioning cost at the end often have zero, two or more IRRs, and spreadsheet IRR quietly returns just one.
